title: Total Drive - Cloud Storage
summary: Secure Cloud Storage with Neverlost™ Technology
description:
Description:
At Total Drive, safeguarding your digital assets is our top priority. Our reliable cloud system keeps your files safe, secure, and always within reach.

Features at a Glance:

► Effortless Upload: Automatically back up all the photos and videos on your iPhone or iPad.

► Reliable Data Protection: Your files are not just stored—they're fortified against loss, corruption, and ransomware, thanks to our cutting-edge security measures.

► Universal Access & Sync: Access your files from any device, anywhere. Enjoy seamless sync across all your devices, ensuring your data is always current.

► Dynamic Sharing Options: Share files effortlessly with full control. Grant and retract access instantly, ensuring your sensitive information remains secure, even on the go.


► Secure Family Sharing: Create secure shared family albums for safely sharing photos of your children/grandchildren with your family members.

► Ransomware Defense: In the era of ransomware, Total Drive protects your valuable files from cyber extortion, and ultimately precious file loss.

► Intuitive File Management: Organize, manage, and access your files with ease. Our user-friendly interface makes navigation straightforward, allowing you to focus more on what matters.

Choose Total Drive for a worry-free cloud storage experience. By combining advanced security technologies with user-friendly features, we provide a storage solution that not only protects but enhances your digital life.


Sign up for Total Drive today and take the first step towards ultimate data protection. With Total Drive, your digital assets are not just stored; they're shielded, maintained, and made easily accessible.
Please note that this app requires a Total Drive account (monthly or annual subscription).
